data: Roamed 39 km on the Moon — record till 2014
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
Lunokhod 2 is a planetary rover built by NPO Lavochkin in USSR. Roamed 39 km on the Moon — record till 2014. Mission ended in 1973.
Second Soviet lunar rover; longest off-world drive (~39 km) for over 40 years
The Soviet / Russian heavy-lift workhorse 1967-2012 — Salyut, Mir, Venera, Vega, Luna sample-return
First wheeled vehicle to roam another world
Twin to Spirit; nearly 15-year Mars operation

Lunokhod 2 was the second of two Soviet lunar rovers (1973). Driven by a 5-person ground crew rotating in shifts at the IKI control centre. In 4 months it covered ~39 km — the lunar-surface distance record that stood for 41 years until NASA's Opportunity Mars rover passed it in 2014. Carried French laser retroreflectors that are still used for Earth-Moon ranging today.
